project.name: html-finetune-notion
project.businessContext: HTML 可视化微调工作台的 Notion 风格完整 UI 设计稿
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Notion 纸面风格：暖灰底色 (#fbfbfa / #f7f6f3)、蓝主色 (#2383e2 / #4dabf7)、4-6px 圆角、1px 静态边框、极淡 contact shadow、Inter 字体、ease-out 动效

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: radius 4-6px; border 1px solid; no glass/blur; single-layer contact shadow
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter 400-600, 10-16px; mono (SF Mono / JetBrains Mono) for code, 11-12px
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: Minimal, paper-like: subtle bg-on-hover, 1px border, single shadow layer, no scale/spring transforms
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Static borders + light shadow (alpha <= 0.05 for cards, <= 0.14 for overlays); no backdrop-filter; no gradients
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: SVG 14-16px in --n-fg-secondary; no colored icons except brand actions
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: 120-240ms ease-out; no spring overshoot; no active scale

pages.scenario: 主工作区亮色 — 三栏布局 + 顶栏工具栏 + Stage 预览
主工作区暗色 — 三栏布局暗色版本
空状态欢迎页 — 未导入 HTML 时的引导界面
DOM 树面板激活 — 左侧切换到 DOM Tree 层级视图
视口切换 — Stage 以手机/平板外框预览
颜色选择器弹层 — ColorField 完整面板
下拉菜单 — CustomSelect/全局菜单/右键菜单
Toast + Tooltip + 控件集合展示
诊断/错误面板 — Inspector 中的警告与错误
移动端抽屉布局 — 760px 以下的响应式视图
